decisions.reason: The source reports failure of the Hero V and second V hierarchy and ends further revisions, but it does not change or cancel the established peak-alignment relationship between the Hero V and É accent.
Removing the second-V hierarchy Requirement does not entail changing the separately established bottom-point baseline alignment, and the source does not remove the second V from the wordmark.

The project-ending decision does not revise the selected Satin Reflection finish or champagne-gold distribution; the reference to the second V concerns failed geometry and hierarchy rather than removal of the second V design element.
The proof-format Requirement is unrelated to the removed second-V hierarchy, and the source makes no change to acceptable attachment formats.
